source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by white)
units: pixels, seconds; image coords x right, y down, origin top-left

camera.motion: static (rock region phase-correlation shift vs frame 0 < 0.6 px every frame, compression noise)
camera.view: steep high-angle view looking down (boat deck and person's head/shoulders seen from above); no horizon, no ground plane texture (background removed)

duplicate_frames.note: each is (almost) pixel-identical to the previous frame for ALL objects: 1==0, 26==25, 51==50. Pattern of one repeat per 25 frames suggests a 24 fps render resampled to 25 fps. Per-frame backward-difference displacement is ~0 at these frames.

boat.description: red-and-white fishing boat (red hull, white deck, red wheelhouse roof, mast with antenna, black exhaust pipe, teal hatch); bow points left, stern lower right; the only vehicle
boat.visible_frames: 0-74 (bow cut by left image edge from frame 66 on)
boat.reference_point: ref_x/ref_y = frame-0 filled-mask centroid (748.4,1411.3) + rigid template-match shift of the stern half; approximates the hull centre / root in projection. Mast and pipe pull the mask centroid upward by a few px.
boat.motion: straight line toward image left and slightly up; ~8.1 px/frame in x, ~2.3 px/frame in y (|d| ~8.4 px/frame) between non-duplicate frames; total shift frame 0->74 = (-573.9, -161.0) px; no rotation (main-axis angle constant -158.6 +-0.5 deg)
boat.apparent_size_change: main-axis length 512 px (frame 0) -> 507 px (frame 65), ~1% shrink: moving very slightly away from camera

person.description: single adult human (white T-shirt, light-blue jeans, dark shoes, short dark hair), small, seen from above in the middle-left of the image; walking
person.reference_point: ref_x/ref_y = filled-mask centroid (proxy for pelvis; the body is foreshortened from above so the pelvis lies near mask middle)
person.motion: walks toward image bottom (slight drift right): centroid (512.0,549.7) at frame 0 -> (523.1,704.1) at frame 74; ~2.1 px/frame; head top y 520 -> 674
person.pixel_size: mask length along body 54-71 px (oscillates with stride), width 24-28 px, bbox width 24-28 px; no size trend over time

rock.description: large brown/beige rounded rock or boulder (dark shading on its right part) at top centre-right, cut off by the top image edge
rock.note: true extent unknown (cut by frame top)

events.event: video start; boat and person already moving
boat bow reaches left image edge (boat partly out of frame from here)
last frame; both still moving, no stops, no direction changes, no contacts
